categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Does not change IPC infrastructure, serialization, connection handling, or the capnp toolchain, which the ipc category requires for mining-related interface PRs.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies `src/interfaces/mining.h` and mining initialization logic in `src/node/interfaces.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion failure and node abort when external mining clients call `Mining.checkBlock` during startup before the active chain tip is connected. While limited to a narrow startup or reindex race window, fixing an unhandled crash in the mining interface is a clear stability improvement.
